Ashford Arthritis and Rheumatology
Rheumatology Follow-up
Patient: Kira Baptiste | DOB: 05/26/1957 | MRN: SYN-5790040
Date of service: 09/24/2025 | Dr. Ravi Fenwick, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
68-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: type 2 diabetes, hypertension.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
She has taken weekly methotrexate (15 mg) for the better part of nine months, yet the small joints of both hands remain swollen.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: active seropositive rheumatoid arthritis; clinical disease activity index nineteen today.
Latent TB blood test and hepatitis B panel drawn on 07/22/2025 both came back clear.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
